name: astroflix
description: Programa desktop para assistir aos cursos que estão nas suas pastas, com progresso confiável.
author: OnaitsirC-MiromA

scripts.dev:servicos: node scripts/gerar-bundled.mjs && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "pnpm --filter server dev" "pnpm --filter web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter web build && node scripts/gerar-bundled.mjs && pnpm --filter server build && node scripts/empacotar.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/gerar-bundled.mjs && pnpm --filter server test && pnpm --filter web test
scripts.desktop:preparar: pnpm build && pnpm build:binario && node scripts/preparar-sidecar.mjs && node scripts/sincronizar-versao.mjs
scripts.desktop:build: pnpm desktop:preparar && pnpm --filter desktop tauri build
